# The Morning Upgrade

> The Morning Upgrade (themorningupgrades.com) sells CoreJava in the United States, an instant coffee made by MarketPlace Global with MCT powder from coconut, caffeine and L-theanine among its ingredients (the full Supplement Facts panel is on the ingredients page). 1 level scoop in 8 fl oz of hot water makes a cup, and a bag holds 30 servings. The site is run by Rector & Stull LLC, an independent sales representative (ISR) of MarketPlace Global; Rector & Stull is not the manufacturer.

Facts as stated on the site (updated 2026-11-05):

- Price: $79.95 for 1 bag (30 servings), or $69.95 a month with Subscribe & Save (1 bag every 30 days; pause, skip or cancel anytime from the receipt link).
- Serving: 1 level scoop (7 g) in 8 fl oz of hot water. 30 servings per 7.5 oz (213 g) bag. Dark roast; works black, with creamer or over ice.
- Caffeine: 150 mg per scoop in total, from the instant coffee and a coffee (Coffea robusta) bean extract, as printed on the Supplement Facts panel.
- Supplement Facts per scoop (as printed on the bag): Calories 25; Total Fat 1 g; Cholesterol &lt;5 mg; Total Carbohydrate 3 g; Calcium 90 mg; Chromium (as ChromeMate® chromium polynicotinate) 600 mcg; Potassium 280 mg; Dark Roast Colombian Instant Coffee 3000 mg; Medium-Chain Triglycerides (Coconut MCT Oil and Acacia Fiber) 1500 mg; Garcinia cambogia Extract (fruit rind) (60% HCA) 1500 mg; L-Theanine 400 mg; Caffeine (from Dark Roast Colombian Instant Coffee, Coffee (Coffea robusta) Bean Extract) 150 mg; Paradoxine® (Aframomum melegueta) Extract 40 mg; SAFFR’ACTIV® (Crocus sativus L.) Extract 30 mg. Other ingredients: Natural Flavors, Silicon Dioxide. Contains tree nuts (coconut).
- Names people search: CoreJava, Core Java coffee, MarketPlace Global coffee. Item CL805. This site is an independent ISR's store, not MarketPlace Global's own site.
- Shipping: US addresses only, flat $8.95 per bag. Orders ship from Minnesota within about 2 business days, then 3-6 days in transit.
- Returns: the maker's 90-day money-back guarantee on unopened bags; damaged or incorrect items are replaced if reported within 30 days of delivery.
- Contains caffeine. For adults; not for children or anyone pregnant or nursing. Ask a physician first if you take medication or have a medical condition.
- Product copy quotes the label rather than adding claims of its own. The guides are general information, not medical advice.
- People shown in the site's videos are AI presenters, and the site says so.
- House coffees (separate from CoreJava, not MarketPlace Global products): Cup of Joe Everyday Coffee, 100% ground coffee, 12 oz (340 g), $27.95 a bag, roast chosen at checkout (Light, Medium from Colombia, or Dark); and The Morning Upgrade Mushroom Coffee Blend, medium roast coffee with mushroom powder, 12 oz (340 g), $33.95 a bag. One-time orders only. Roasted to order by a roasting partner; ships in about 2-3 business days, then 3-6 days in transit; $5.95 flat US shipping. No returns on opened coffee; damaged or wrong bags replaced within 30 days. The CoreJava 90-day guarantee does not apply. Pages: https://themorningupgrades.com/cup-of-joe.html and https://themorningupgrades.com/mushroom-coffee-blend.html.
- Shop: https://themorningupgrades.com/shop.html lists all 3 coffees; CoreJava's product page is https://themorningupgrades.com/corejava.html.
- Contact: hello@themorningupgrades.com. Rector & Stull LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801.

## Guides

- [What Is MCT Coffee? MCT Oil vs. Powder](https://themorningupgrades.com/what-is-mct-coffee.html): MCT coffee is coffee with medium-chain triglycerides added, as an oil you blend in or a powder you stir in. What MCTs are and how oil and powder differ.
- [How to Make Instant MCT Coffee (1 Scoop)](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-to-make-mct-instant-coffee.html): 1 level scoop in 8 fl oz of hot water, stirred until dissolved. Plus iced and latte-style, and instant coffee with MCT oil if that's what you have.
- [L-Theanine Coffee & Caffeine Explained](https://themorningupgrades.com/l-theanine-and-caffeine.html): L-theanine coffee is coffee with the tea amino acid added alongside caffeine. 3 ways to get it, how to read the label, and what small studies found.
- [MCT Coffee vs. Butter Coffee, Compared](https://themorningupgrades.com/mct-coffee-vs-butter-coffee.html): Butter coffee is coffee blended with butter and usually MCT oil; MCT coffee adds MCT oil or powder, no butter. How prep, texture and travel compare.
- [Iced Instant Coffee, No Clumps: 3 Recipes](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-instant-coffee-recipes.html): Dissolve hot, then go cold: the trick for smooth iced instant coffee, plus iced classic, iced oat vanilla and a blended frappé.
- [How Much Caffeine Is in Instant Coffee?](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-much-caffeine-in-instant-coffee.html): USDA data: about 62 mg in an 8 fl oz cup of instant coffee vs. about 95 mg brewed. What changes the number, and how to read a label.
- [How to Make Instant Coffee Taste Better](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-to-make-instant-coffee-taste-better.html): 6 fixes for better instant coffee: water just off the boil, the right ratio, a paste first, a pinch of salt, milk, and keeping the jar dry.
- [Does Instant Coffee Go Bad? Storage Tips](https://themorningupgrades.com/does-instant-coffee-go-bad.html): Instant coffee goes stale rather than spoiling, but moisture can ruin it. What the date means, signs it's past its best, and how to store it.
- [Instant Coffee for Travel, Camping & Dorms](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-for-travel-camping-dorm.html): How to make good instant coffee away from a kitchen: what to pack, where to find hot water, cold-water backup and flying with coffee powder.
- [What Is MCT Powder? Powder vs. MCT Oil](https://themorningupgrades.com/what-is-mct-powder.html): MCT powder is MCT oil dried onto a carrier like acacia fiber, tapioca or milk protein. What's in it, how it compares to oil, and what to check.
- [Natural vs. Synthetic Caffeine Explained](https://themorningupgrades.com/natural-caffeine-vs-synthetic.html): Natural and synthetic caffeine are the same molecule; the label word tells you the source. Where each comes from and what to check on a label.
- [Caffeine and L-Theanine Ratio in Studies](https://themorningupgrades.com/caffeine-and-l-theanine-ratio.html): The caffeine and L-theanine doses small studies used, how to work out a product's ratio from its label, and what the research can't tell you.
- [Instant vs. Drip Coffee: Cost per Cup](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-vs-drip-cost-per-cup.html): How to work out cost per cup for instant, drip, pods and café coffee, with a calculator and the extras people forget to count.
- [Instant Coffee Subscription: What to Check](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-subscription.html): How an instant coffee subscription works and what to check first: cost per cup with shipping, delivery timing, pausing and cancelling, damaged bags.
- [How Late Can You Drink Coffee? Timing It](https://themorningupgrades.com/how-late-can-you-drink-coffee.html): Like a cup after lunch? How late is too late for caffeine, what a sleep study found, and an afternoon break without the cup.
- [What Is Functional Coffee? What to Check](https://themorningupgrades.com/what-is-functional-coffee.html): Functional coffee is coffee with something added: MCT, L-theanine, caffeine, mushroom extracts or protein. What each is and how to read the label.
- [Mushroom Coffee vs. MCT Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/mushroom-coffee-vs-mct-coffee.html): Mushroom coffee adds powdered mushroom extract; MCT coffee adds MCT oil or powder from coconut. How flavor, texture, caffeine and labels compare.

## Recipes

- [Instant Coffee Recipes: Iced, Hot, Blended](https://themorningupgrades.com/recipes.html): 12 drinks made with instant coffee: iced coffee, frappé, latte, mocha, cold foam, dalgona, affogato and more. Steps, times and tips for each.
- [Iced Instant Coffee Recipe (No Clumps)](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-instant-coffee-recipe.html): Iced instant coffee in 2 minutes: dissolve the coffee in a little hot water first, then pour over ice and top up. No clumps, no machine.
- [Iced Oat Milk Vanilla Coffee (Instant)](https://themorningupgrades.com/iced-oat-milk-vanilla-coffee.html): An iced vanilla oat milk coffee made with instant coffee: a hot coffee base, ice, cold oat milk and 1 drop of vanilla. Ready in 3 minutes.
- [Instant Coffee Frappé Recipe (3 Minutes)](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-frappe.html): A blended coffee frappé with instant coffee, milk, ice and a little honey: how to get it thick and how to keep it from separating.
- [How to Make a Latte with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-latte.html): A latte with instant coffee: a strong instant coffee base topped with steamed or frothed milk. Stovetop, microwave and handheld-frother methods.
- [Mocha with Instant Coffee: Hot or Iced](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-mocha.html): A mocha made with instant coffee and cocoa powder: dissolve both in a little hot water, then add hot or cold milk. Hot and iced versions.
- [Cinnamon Instant Coffee (No Grit)](https://themorningupgrades.com/cinnamon-instant-coffee.html): How to add cinnamon to instant coffee without a gritty cup: bloom it in the hot water, sweeten while hot, or use a cinnamon stick. Hot and iced.
- [Coffee Protein Shake with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-protein-shake.html): A blended coffee protein shake with instant coffee, milk, ice and a scoop of protein powder. How to keep it smooth and how to make it without a blender.
- [Coffee Ice Cubes from Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/coffee-ice-cubes.html): Coffee ice cubes keep iced coffee from going watery. How to make them from instant coffee, how long they keep, and 3 ways to use them.
- [Affogato with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-affogato.html): An affogato with instant coffee: a strong, small instant coffee poured hot over a scoop of vanilla ice cream. 2 ingredients, 2 minutes.
- [Dalgona Whipped Coffee with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/dalgona-whipped-coffee.html): Dalgona whipped coffee: instant coffee, sugar and hot water whipped into a thick foam over milk. The ratio, the whisking time and a serving note.
- [Pumpkin Spice Coffee with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/pumpkin-spice-instant-coffee.html): A pumpkin spice latte at home with instant coffee: pumpkin purée, pumpkin pie spice, a little sugar and hot milk. Hot or iced, no syrup needed.
- [Coffee Cold Foam with Instant Coffee](https://themorningupgrades.com/instant-coffee-cold-foam.html): Café-style cold foam at home: froth cold skim milk with a little sugar for 20 seconds and spoon it over iced instant coffee. Plain or vanilla.
